# GENERATED FILE. DO NOT EDIT.
# Source: tools/auto_upgrade_buildings_1_19_0_6.json

aub_start_global_loop_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = aub_auto_build_loop_started } }
		set_global_variable = { name = aub_auto_build_loop_started value = 1 }
		trigger_event = { id = auto_build.0005 days = 1 }
	}
}

aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= $GOLD$ } }
		scope:aub_payer = { remove_short_term_treasury = $GOLD$ }
	}
	else = {
		scope:aub_payer = { remove_short_term_gold = $GOLD$ }
	}
}

aub_pay_gold_prestige_building_cost_effect = {
	aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = $GOLD$ }
	scope:aub_payer = {
		add_prestige = {
			value = $PRESTIGE$
			multiply = -1
		}
	}
}

aub_pay_gold_piety_building_cost_effect = {
	aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = $GOLD$ }
	scope:aub_payer = {
		add_piety = {
			value = $PIETY$
			multiply = -1
		}
	}
}

# alamut_castle_01: 1 frozen upgrade edge(s)
aub_upgrade_chain_alamut_castle_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = alamut_castle_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_alamut_castle_02_trigger = yes
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= 600 }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= 600 }
			}
			scope:aub_payer = { piety >= 400 }
		}
		add_building = alamut_castle_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = alamut_castle_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_piety_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = 600 PIETY = 400 }
		}
	}
}

aub_upgrade_chain_hagia_sophia_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = hagia_sophia_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_hagia_sophia_02_trigger = yes
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= 1000 }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= 1000 }
			}
			scope:aub_payer = { piety >= 1000 }
		}
		add_building = hagia_sophia_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = hagia_sophia_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_piety_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = 1000 PIETY = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

	}
